changeSet.author: niis

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = 'ds-issuer-service'

changeSet.comment: Grants the ds-issuer-service role schema usage and read access to the issuer identity, so every Issuer Service node can read the bound identity directly from this schema. Runs on every migration, including after a restore, since a restored dump carries no privileges. A no-op, without error, while that role does not exist yet.
